environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough on port 443). Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional middleware or proxy filtering. Flask runs directly via gunicorn with 4 workers. The ELB performs TLS termination but does no request inspection. SQLite database is local on EBS volume.

config.load_balancer: AWS Classic ELB, TCP passthrough mode
